packs.loads_in: displayxr-demo-modelviewer >= the release containing #160 (native MaterialX OpenPBR)

known_divergences: Dome light HDRI (bonifacio_aragon_stairs.exr) is not in the upstream asset: no dome fill.
No bounce light: shadowed regions read darker than the published Arnold stills.
Transmissive materials cast no shadow (Arnold casts coloured transmission shadows).
walls: the authored normal-map override (wall_Normal_G.tif) is not a unit-length tangent map; walls render dark.
